reviews.text: I’ve played this game on and off for the better part of 4 or so years and the game is an absolute joy to play once you understand all of the systems and get yourself through the early game slog. The characters mechanic and design-wise are all feel very unique and you can tell a lot of care goes into the development of the characters. The crossover events that come in the form of “dimensional” heroes are fun, albeit incredibly difficult for the average low-mid game player to acquire. My only gripe is that sometimes it feels like you never have enough of the resources you need to progress, which can slow down your enjoyment of the game. In the long run however the game can become very rewarding and fun to play. Big events are pre-coordinated with big guilds so if you want to win you need to be in there, otherwise you basically have 0 chance at anything. All in all, the stuff you do get to play is tedious, game play is less strategy and more luck of the draw on power gains.
